status: Analysis working model; no phase acceptance

models.name: state-resume-draft-publication
models.title: Independent draft and live presentation context

states.Aligned: Live presentation and saved draft aligned
states.Changed: Live unchanged; saved draft has unapplied-to-live changes

transitions.guard: Authorized source edit only; no resume apply/publish request
transitions.effect: Keep existing resume content and no-publication condition unchanged

transitions.guard: Explicit selected application; current authority/context; save confirmed
transitions.effect: Retain intended independent draft and overrides; do not publish

transitions.guard: Separate explicit confirmation; eligible intended content; publication actually confirmed
transitions.effect: Make intended presentation effective; actual submitted documents unchanged

transitions.guard: Explicit permitted apply or independent edit; actual save confirmed
transitions.effect: Change intended draft only; preserve live content, other resumes and independent text

transitions.guard: Separate confirmation of current intended content; actual eligible publication confirmed
transitions.effect: Make reviewed presentation effective without changing actual submitted material

transitions.guard: Source changed without explicit resume action
transitions.effect: No automatic draft/live update

transitions.guard: Source changed without explicit resume action
transitions.effect: Preserve existing draft/live difference and independent content

models.scope: One resume context observed across its editable content and effective presentation. Aligned/diverged are descriptive relationships, not a selected revision-storage design.
models.invariant: Source editing and preview alone cannot publish or change existing resume content; explicit apply/save and separately confirmed publication remain different.
models.limit: A marks the accepted Q-D07 behavior, not owner acceptance of these abstract state labels. Preview is an observation, not a persistent business-state transition. Failed/unknown save or publish uses SM-M18; do not infer rollback or a known current revision.

models.name: state-account-eligibility
models.title: Proposed account access eligibility

transitions.guard: Intended recipient control and reviewed onboarding verified; actual activation confirmed
transitions.effect: Establish active account context without unrelated resource grants

transitions.guard: Exact permitted account-state power and actual suspension completion
transitions.effect: Apply reviewed account-access consequences; retain data under policy

transitions.guard: Reviewed reinstatement authority and eligibility; no authentication-recovery bypass
transitions.effect: Re-establish only permitted account access; do not resurrect unrelated grants

transitions.guard: Reviewed closure/deletion eligibility and actual accepted state change
transitions.effect: Record deletion-pending; no immediate data purge inferred

transitions.guard: Reviewed closure policy permits change despite suspension; actual result confirmed
transitions.effect: Preserve applicable references and restrictions

models.scope: Access-eligibility context under Q-D03; Pending refers to proposed invitation-based onboarding, not public registration.
models.invariant: Account activation or administrator label is not universal data authority; suspension is not deletion, and recovery does not bypass suspension.
models.limit: All enumeration/onboarding/restoration details remain proposed. Deletion-pending is not proof of reclaimed data; category-specific retention handles that separately. No invitation/session timeout, password value or factor mechanism is chosen.

models.name: state-collaboration-grant
models.title: Invitation and scoped grant instance

transitions.guard: Recipient/resource eligibility and actual acceptance/grant completion
transitions.effect: Establish only intended resource/action membership

transitions.guard: An expiry policy is adopted and its condition actually holds
transitions.effect: Invitation cannot newly grant membership

transitions.guard: Current authority permits exact change; result confirmed
transitions.effect: Apply new scoped rights; unrelated resources unchanged

transitions.guard: Reviewed removal authority and effective change confirmed
transitions.effect: Use current grant state for later applicable authorization decisions

models.scope: One invitation/grant instance for an explicit resource. Project and repository grants are separate contexts.
models.invariant: Invitation is not effective membership before confirmation; revocation does not delete unrelated owned resources.
models.limit: Q-D04/Q-D05 remain proposed, including active/in-flight timing. Expiry exists only if adopted; no duration is invented. Restoring data does not reactivate this revoked instance. Any fresh grant needs its own authorized lifecycle.

models.name: state-protected-link
models.title: Enabled link is separate from current retrieval eligibility

transitions.guard: Reviewed owner authority; required password and intended publication conditions; actual enablement confirmed
transitions.effect: Allow only subsequent eligible scoped requests

transitions.guard: Specific owner-control authority; effective disablement confirmed
transitions.effect: Deny fresh protected access through link; PDF configuration stays independent

transitions.guard: Authorized credential change actually confirmed
transitions.effect: Apply reviewed credential/session consequences without changing PDF mode

transitions.guard: Separate permitted PDF configuration save
transitions.effect: Keep disabled link state; availability does not re-enable link

transitions.guard: Separate permitted PDF configuration save
transitions.effect: Keep enabled link state; neither mode does not disable page/link

models.scope: Link enabled/disabled state from Q-D11 is distinct from per-request eligibility, optional expiry, selected disclosure and artifact availability.
models.invariant: Fresh access through an effectively disabled link is denied. Already delivered bytes cannot be recalled.
models.limit: Initial disabled, re-enable and password/session details are proposals. Expiry is evaluated as an adopted eligibility condition, not invented as a third persisted link state. Existing/in-flight response timing stays Q-D05/Q-D11 policy.

models.name: state-artifact-availability
models.title: Candidate admission and confirmed usable artifact

transitions.guard: Intended resource/language; applicable validation/policy/authority permits processing
transitions.effect: Retain pending candidate context; no usable-success claim

transitions.guard: Applicable authority/content/size/quota rule denies candidate
transitions.effect: Do not expose candidate as usable content

transitions.guard: Actual validated usable content and intended association confirmed
transitions.effect: Make this artifact available under its own authority/provenance

transitions.guard: Required processing definitively failed
transitions.effect: Report failed candidate without false availability

transitions.guard: Different source/publication changed; this artifact identity/content not replaced
transitions.effect: Retain bytes/identity; recompute eligibility for requested revision separately

models.scope: One candidate/artifact instance, not a worker-process state. Awaiting completion means no usable result is confirmed, including unresolved processing.
models.invariant: Available is not authorization or matching-current-revision eligibility. A failed replacement candidate does not by itself destroy the prior usable association.
models.limit: Generation/replacement/retirement details remain Q-D08/Q-D10/Q-D24 proposals. Replacement uses a distinguishable candidate; do not loop a failed candidate into a fabricated success. Draft previews remain distinguished from employer-facing published renditions.

models.name: state-application-progress
models.title: Proposed manual application progress

transitions.guard: Reviewed preparation/material readiness rules hold; authorized result confirmed
transitions.effect: Record Ready without claiming external submission

transitions.guard: Authorized actual submission context recorded under reviewed policy
transitions.effect: Record Submitted; complete captured material is a separate condition

transitions.guard: Permitted explicit progress change with attributable context
transitions.effect: Record Interview; no automatic inference from email/calendar

transitions.guard: Reviewed explicit transition and evidence/attribution conditions
transitions.effect: Record Offer without rewriting submitted documents

transitions.guard: Reviewed permitted progress transition
transitions.effect: Record intended offer context

transitions.guard: Explicit permitted change/correction under progress policy
transitions.effect: Record rejection with applicable history

transitions.guard: Explicit permitted progress update
transitions.effect: Retain actual outcome/history

transitions.guard: Reviewed explicit withdrawal transition
transitions.effect: Record withdrawal without undoing past submission

transitions.guard: Reviewed explicit withdrawal transition
transitions.effect: Retain actual prior history

models.scope: Q-D12 normal manual progress routes. A progress label is neither receipt proof nor proof that actual document capture completed.
models.invariant: Submitted requires a recorded actual event; progress, captured-set completeness and external receipt stay separate.
models.limit: Other corrections, direct manual-channel entry and offer acceptance/decline use explicit reviewed history rules; no silent arbitrary reset is granted. This selected normal-route model is not an accepted exhaustive transition matrix. Offer outcome can be attributed without inventing additional accepted progress states.

models.name: state-submitted-set-completeness
models.title: Actual submitted-set completeness

transitions.guard: Actual event/material and capture authority identified; explicit permitted capture
transitions.effect: Assess actual intended material; retain prior partial/history context

transitions.guard: Every required actual material/provenance condition confirmed
transitions.effect: Report complete identifiable actual set, not inferred current source

transitions.guard: Known missing or incomplete required capture
transitions.effect: Report incomplete set without false full preservation

transitions.guard: Result evidence cannot establish completed or failed capture
transitions.effect: Retain unknown outcome; reconcile before new consequential action

transitions.guard: Evidence confirms required actual material is preserved
transitions.effect: Record bounded confirmed complete set

transitions.guard: Evidence establishes missing/incomplete actual material
transitions.effect: Record honest incomplete result

transitions.guard: Only a later source, draft or publication change occurred
transitions.effect: Keep actual submitted documents unchanged

transitions.guard: Required actual material is definitely unavailable, not merely denied to a caller
transitions.effect: Report unavailable history rather than substitute a live artifact

transitions.guard: Same actual material identity/content/provenance verified under recovery policy
transitions.effect: Restore truthful confirmed availability without fabricated current substitutes

models.scope: Completeness of one recorded actual submission set; application progress and current retrieval authority are separate subjects.
models.invariant: A missing file or ambiguous capture cannot satisfy complete-preserved-copy acceptance. Later live changes do not rewrite actual submitted material.
models.limit: Q-D13/Q-D14 capture/correction/retry details remain proposed. A new submission or correction/version is distinguishable from this set; do not silently replace the original. A caller-specific access denial does not itself prove global material loss.

models.name: state-provider-connection
models.title: Usable provider capability versus disconnected data

transitions.guard: Explicit consent/identity/scopes and actual usable connection verified
transitions.effect: Establish only permitted provider capability; no automatic stale replay

transitions.guard: Applicable required capability is no longer usable
transitions.effect: Prevent new dependent protected operations; retained copies have freshness limits

transitions.guard: Authorized disconnect actually completed under policy
transitions.effect: Stop dependent fetch/push/reminder work; preserve reviewed local data semantics

transitions.guard: Permitted disconnect cleanup confirmed
transitions.effect: Do not imply provider-owned content was deleted

transitions.guard: Explicit applicable reconnect; actual identity/permission verified
transitions.effect: Restore current capability, then reconcile mappings/pending work separately

transitions.guard: Actual capabilities changed but required selected operation remains eligible
transitions.effect: Re-evaluate operation-specific rights; no entire-account disclosure

models.scope: Usability of the selected provider/account capability, not a token-store design or a claim that all provider operations are allowed.
models.invariant: Connected/usable is not synchronized/fresh local content or permission to act on every accessible calendar. Disconnect does not silently send/delete/replay.
models.limit: Q-D15 setup/access is missing now; initial not-connected is consistent with that fact. Q-D17 retained-data/reconnect details remain proposals. No token value, refresh algorithm or account-global source of truth is selected.

models.name: state-mail-send-attempt
models.title: Provider acceptance and unknown mail outcome

transitions.guard: Sender/recipient/content/attachment set changes before submit
transitions.effect: Require renewed final review; no send follows automatically

transitions.guard: Wrong/missing account, resource or provider capability prevents action
transitions.effect: No protected provider submission

transitions.guard: Current reviewed final intent; permitted sender/thread/recipients and usable capability
transitions.effect: Submit only intended message and retain account/item context

transitions.guard: Actual provider acceptance/reference supports this claim
transitions.effect: Report accepted, not recipient delivered/read

transitions.guard: Definite provider rejection/failure is established
transitions.effect: Report rejected without confusing timeout and definite failure

transitions.guard: Evidence does not establish provider effect
transitions.effect: Retain unknown result and prevent blind automatic duplicate send

transitions.guard: Evidence identifies accepted intended message in its correct account/thread context
transitions.effect: Record bounded provider acceptance

transitions.guard: Authoritative evidence establishes definite rejected/no-accepted-effect disposition
transitions.effect: Record known rejection; absence of immediate search result alone is insufficient

models.scope: One deliberately requested send/reply attempt, not the lifetime of an entire email thread or a draft-save operation.
models.invariant: Accepted is not delivered or read. Unknown is not failed, safe-to-repeat or proof no effect occurred.
models.limit: Q-D16 safe retry and provider reconciliation are proposals; actual OAuth is not created. Retrying requires a separately authorized distinguishable attempt after the reviewed disposition, not an automatic Unknown→InFlight loop.

models.name: state-calendar-mapping
models.title: Local/provider mapping and freshness

transitions.guard: Selected provider/account/event mapping permitted and actual result confirmed
transitions.effect: Identify mapped fields and preserve local-only notes/associations

transitions.guard: Mapped version changes or dependent connection becomes unusable
transitions.effect: Mark retained mapped information stale rather than currently synchronized

transitions.guard: Reviewed local/provider version evidence conflicts
transitions.effect: Do not silently overwrite with last-write-wins

transitions.guard: Current comparable evidence establishes competing edits
transitions.effect: Keep conflict visible until explicit resolution

transitions.guard: Usable capability and actual permitted refreshed field context confirmed
transitions.effect: Re-establish only confirmed mapped freshness

transitions.guard: Explicit permitted resolution and actual resulting provider/local outcome confirmed
transitions.effect: Preserve local-only meaning and record actual selected mapping

transitions.guard: Actual intended provider event deletion established
transitions.effect: Report mapped event unavailable; do not invent a replacement

transitions.guard: Explicit permitted local association removal
transitions.effect: Do not delete the provider event solely because local association was removed

transitions.guard: Reviewed permitted local mapping change
transitions.effect: Retain permitted local meaning and history without recreating provider content

models.scope: Mapping/freshness of an activity, not provider connection status, reminder delivery or the whole account calendar.
models.invariant: Local save does not automatically publish externally; reconnect alone does not prove a stale mapping fresh or recreate a deleted event.
models.limit: Q-D17 direction, version, conflict, deletion and reconnect rules are proposed. Unknown provider writes use SM-M18 and cannot establish Fresh. A new mapping to another event must have distinguishable intended identity and confirmation.

models.name: state-work-item-task
models.title: Work status with subject-specific completion guards

transitions.guard: Current work/action authority and valid intended state change
transitions.effect: Record in-progress activity/outcome context

transitions.guard: Task: required activity completion; Item: criteria and authorized acceptance actually satisfied
transitions.effect: Record Done for the correct subject; do not derive item acceptance solely from tasks

transitions.guard: Adopted reopen/correction policy permits change with attribution/history
transitions.effect: Preserve prior outcome history and explicit current state

transitions.guard: Column/order/display changed without an actual mapped work-state change
transitions.effect: Keep business work state independent of label/layout

models.scope: One work subject at a time: Task and Backlog Item can share candidate labels without sharing identity or completion authority.
models.invariant: A board move/label or all tasks marked done does not alone satisfy item acceptance; ordering, priority and readiness are different meanings.
models.limit: Q-D18/Q-D19 propose canonical To do/In progress/Done but also refer to Ready. This model treats selection readiness as a separate proposed predicate, not a silently accepted fourth canonical state. Exact direct completion/reopen/column mappings still require primary-policy disposition.

models.name: state-sprint-lifecycle
models.title: Sprint period and recorded actual outcome

transitions.guard: Reviewed start/date/project rules and coherent goal/selected-items/plan hold
transitions.effect: Activate the intended period; no extra team or cadence inferred

transitions.guard: Authorized planned-period cancellation actually confirmed
transitions.effect: Retain identified planning/history context

transitions.guard: Reviewed active-change authority and required goal/scope confirmation/history
transitions.effect: Retain one coherent Sprint Backlog with attributable adaptation

transitions.guard: Actual goal/item outcomes and explicit incomplete-work disposition recorded
transitions.effect: End period with history; completion does not imply goal achieved/all items accepted

transitions.guard: Authorized cancellation and actual work disposition confirmed
transitions.effect: Preserve goal/items/plan/history; no automatic carry-over

models.scope: Lifecycle of a Sprint period; goal success, accepted-item counts and incomplete work are separate outcomes.
models.invariant: One coherent Sprint Backlog remains goal + selected items + delivery plan. Elapsed time is not automatic completion or success.
models.limit: Q-D19 enumeration, active-Sprint count and change/end policies remain proposed. A completed/cancelled period is not deleted; future Sprint selection is explicit. Corrections and historical reporting must not rewrite earlier meaning.

models.name: state-pull-request-lifecycle
models.title: Request lifecycle with revision-specific eligibility

transitions.guard: Review targets the intended current evaluated revision; actual record confirmed
transitions.effect: Retain attributable review evidence, not universal merge authority

transitions.guard: Actual source/target revision differs from evaluated context
transitions.effect: Invalidate/re-evaluate applicable review/check eligibility without pretending request merged

transitions.guard: Current source/target authority, reviewed checks/review eligibility and actual integration confirmed
transitions.effect: Record actual integrated context; no deployment authority inherited

transitions.guard: Reviewed close authority and actual request-state change confirmed
transitions.effect: Retain discussion/revision history without integration claim

models.scope: Lifecycle of one pull request. Current review/check eligibility is revision-specific accompanying information rather than a second accepted request-state enum.
models.invariant: Open does not imply merge-ready. A source change invalidates prior approval under the proposal; target changes need re-evaluation. Closed is not Merged.
models.limit: Q-D22 review counts, solo-owner exception, merge strategy, reopen/correction and release mutations remain proposed. Unknown merge results require actual-ref reconciliation via SM-M18; do not assert Open or Merged merely from a lost response.

models.name: state-execution-attempt
models.title: Actual attempt, cancellation request and runner uncertainty

transitions.guard: Required enabling/current authority/isolation/resources hold; actual start confirmed
transitions.effect: Bind evaluated code/definition and bounded attempt context

transitions.guard: Authorized queue cancellation actually confirmed before execution
transitions.effect: Record cancelled attempt; no execution termination inferred from request alone

transitions.guard: Actual reviewed required success conditions for this revision/attempt confirmed
transitions.effect: Record success; output availability/access and target approval remain separate

transitions.guard: Actual definite failed result under reviewed attempt contract
transitions.effect: Retain failure evidence and any output context

transitions.guard: Current cancellation authority; request recorded
transitions.effect: Do not claim actual termination

transitions.guard: Actual intended attempt termination/cancellation established
transitions.effect: Report cancelled without replaying side effects

transitions.guard: Same attempt actually met success conditions before cancellation took effect
transitions.effect: Report actual success, not invented cancellation

transitions.guard: Same attempt actual definite failure established
transitions.effect: Retain actual failed result, not assumed cancellation

transitions.guard: Current actual attempt state is not established
transitions.effect: Retain unresolved result; no blind retry

transitions.guard: Requested cancellation has no confirmed actual termination/result
transitions.effect: Preserve uncertainty instead of declaring cancelled

transitions.guard: Authoritative evidence confirms the same attempt is still running
transitions.effect: Observe same attempt; do not launch replacement work

transitions.guard: Actual same-attempt required success established
transitions.effect: Record bounded success for evaluated code/definition

transitions.guard: Definite same-attempt failed outcome established
transitions.effect: Retain failure rather than inferring it from timeout

transitions.guard: Same attempt actual cancellation/termination established
transitions.effect: Record confirmed cancellation

models.scope: One admitted attempt, not the request/enabling gate, aggregate multi-job result or lifetime of all retries. Admission/start requires future satisfied enabling conditions.
models.invariant: Cancellation requested is not termination; runner loss is not success or automatically failure. Retrying creates a separately authorized distinguishable attempt.
models.limit: Q-D23 canonical result states and cancellation/retry mechanisms remain proposals; Cancel requested/race handling are explicit R refinements. Real isolation/resources are unproven now. A successful attempt does not imply artifacts are available or deployment approved.

models.name: state-deployment-effect
models.title: Separate target authority and actual deployment effect

transitions.guard: Missing target approval, wrong artifact/revision or unmet readiness conditions
transitions.effect: No target action; run/push/merge success cannot grant approval

transitions.guard: Separate current approval, exact artifact/revision and reviewed target/data/recovery conditions
transitions.effect: Perform only the intended permitted target action

transitions.guard: Actual intended usable target effect verified under the reviewed contract
transitions.effect: Record bounded confirmed deployment; no general release-baseline acceptance

transitions.guard: Definite failure for the defined effect boundary; no blanket rollback inference
transitions.effect: Record actual failed outcome and known limitations

transitions.guard: Some intended effects confirmed while required complete effect is not
transitions.effect: Report partial state; recovery follows explicit reviewed policy

transitions.guard: Evidence cannot establish actual target result
transitions.effect: Prevent blind consequential replay; reconcile target

transitions.guard: Matching intended effect actually confirmed
transitions.effect: Record confirmed target result

transitions.guard: Definite failed disposition established
transitions.effect: Record known failure rather than infer it from silence

transitions.guard: Only bounded partial effects are established
transitions.effect: Retain actual partial-result limitations

models.scope: One bounded target-effect request/attempt with separate authority. A target approval is tied to intended context, not a permanent blanket flag.
models.invariant: No automatic Succeeded transition from push, merge, build, approval alone or timeout. Failed/Partial/Unknown do not promise rollback or safe repeat.
models.limit: These effect labels refine Q-D23/YML-D10 and EIF-D08; they are proposed analysis states. Actual target/execution/recovery suitability remains gated. New corrective action/retry must retain distinguishable context and authority.

models.name: state-reference-aware-retention
models.title: User-managed record retention and actual reclamation

transitions.guard: Category-specific archive policy and actual change confirmed
transitions.effect: Hide from active views as defined; preserve permitted history

transitions.guard: Explicit category-specific restoration eligibility and current authority
transitions.effect: Restore intended visible state without reopening revoked grants

transitions.guard: Reviewed applicable deletion/trash policy permits operation
transitions.effect: Retain protected references/material under adopted retention rules

transitions.guard: Applicable explicit deletion policy and actual request confirmed
transitions.effect: Preserve required historical/reference limits

transitions.guard: Within adopted restoration eligibility; actual material exists; current access reconciled
transitions.effect: Restore only intended record context; do not resend/redeploy/re-enable links

transitions.guard: Applicable retention/removal eligibility, no protected retained references and actual permitted reclamation confirmed
transitions.effect: Report actual reclamation only; do not invent restored material

models.scope: Illustrative user-managed application/content retention proposal from Q-D14; not a universal lifecycle or retention period for every data category.
models.invariant: Archive, unlink, trash, purge and storage accounting are different. Purge eligibility is a condition, not proof that cleanup ran or bytes were reclaimed.
models.limit: No numerical retention period or legal conclusion is selected. Other categories need explicit applicability/coverage. A reclaimed local item cannot be fabricated from a different live resume; actual recovery is assessed separately. Failed/unknown reclamation uses SM-M18.

models.name: state-recovery-assessment
models.title: Gated isolated restoration and demonstrated usable state

transitions.guard: Actual protected source/coverage, isolation, authority and measurement boundaries established
transitions.effect: Identify eligible candidate drill; this is not restore success

transitions.guard: Current authorized isolated conditions and required sources remain valid
transitions.effect: Restore only covered intended candidate information

transitions.guard: Covered information actually restored sufficiently for defined checks
transitions.effect: Evaluate integrity, references, current access and external-state disposition

transitions.guard: Definite missing/corrupt/inconsistent covered material or failed restoration
transitions.effect: Record failed/incomplete evidence, not recovery Pass

transitions.guard: Actual restoration outcome not established
transitions.effect: Retain uncertainty without declaring safe usable state

transitions.guard: Actual integrity/access/external-state findings and measured scenario targets satisfy defined criteria
transitions.effect: Record bounded usable-state evidence and limitations

transitions.guard: Defined integrity/access/target condition fails or remains insufficient
transitions.effect: Record limitations and unmet criteria without successful acceptance

transitions.guard: Actual covered restored candidate identified in safe isolation
transitions.effect: Perform full required checks; reconciliation alone is not Pass

transitions.guard: Actual failed/incomplete recovery disposition established
transitions.effect: Retain honest failed/incomplete assessment

models.scope: One defined isolated drill/assessment, not a proof that a backup job ran or the production system is recovered.
models.invariant: Restored data does not automatically re-enable revoked grants/links, replay sends/deployments or satisfy targets without measurements.
models.limit: Backups are not configured now; Blocked reflects known prerequisites. Q-D26/Q-D27 sources/coverage/targets and actual proof remain gated. Any repeat drill is distinguishable evidence rather than overwriting this assessment. No live restoration is authorized here.

models.name: state-operation-observation
models.title: Observed operation result is separate from subject state

transitions.guard: Applicable resource/action/state or validity condition forbids operation before effect
transitions.effect: Do not perform prohibited action or disclose protected content

transitions.guard: Reviewed current authority/context and eligible request actually accepted
transitions.effect: Retain pending identity/context; request acceptance is not completion

transitions.guard: Actual required postconditions for this specific operation established
transitions.effect: Report bounded success and corresponding known effective data

transitions.guard: Definite operation-boundary failure established
transitions.effect: Report failed result without inventing global rollback

transitions.guard: Known required subset completed but complete claim not established
transitions.effect: Report actual partial result and limitations

transitions.guard: Actual consequential result not established
transitions.effect: Do not infer unchanged subject, failure, success or safe repetition

transitions.guard: Actual matching required postconditions now established
transitions.effect: Record confirmed outcome without rewriting prior uncertainty

transitions.guard: Definite failed disposition now established
transitions.effect: Record failure based on evidence, not missing reply

transitions.guard: Bounded actual partial effects established
transitions.effect: Retain partial-state meaning and reviewed recovery needs

transitions.guard: Evidence confirms same operation remains pending/in progress
transitions.effect: Observe same operation; do not launch a blind duplicate

models.scope: Semantic result vocabulary for a specific operation, including effective policy changes and evidence access; not a universal stored enum or state shared by all domain objects.
models.invariant: Failed/Partial/Unknown does not universally prove old subject state was retained. A pending policy change is not the new effective policy until confirmed; unknown effect needs reconciliation.
models.limit: R/P labels are proposed source-derived refinements of existing failure semantics. A retry/correction is explicit and context-preserving; this model does not choose idempotency, retry timing, locks, transactions or service architecture.

limits: Document checks, not product execution or complete criterion coverage

actual_artifact_checks.limits: Reachability ignores guard satisfiability; document checks are not product tests
